pages.text:
When compared to respondents 
at other types of firms, those at 
management consulting firms 
least often cited AI as a key 
external factor—unsurprising, 
given that management consulting 
is still in the early stages of 
planning for and implementing AI 
technologies into their products, 
services, and processes.
We also find it unsurprising that 
respondents at strategy consulting 
firms reported the most concern 
about the US presidential election 
and geopolitical issues, given that 
much of work is at the board level. 
It makes sense that these issues are 
top of mind for board members. 
For respondents in IT consulting, 
it also makes sense that there was 
slightly less overall focus on interest 
rates and their impact on the 
economy, given that their services 
are in many ways a commodity for 
organizations and are therefore 
less likely to be as significantly 
impacted by economic shifts.
